description: A csp-policy artifact defines the Content-Security-Policy directives for a web application, preventing XSS, clickjacking, and data injection attacks.

rules.description: Policy must declare app name and a directives object containing at least default-src.
script-src must not contain 'unsafe-inline' unless nonce_strategy: true is set.
base-uri must be explicitly declared as 'self' or a specific origin — not wildcard or absent.
frame-ancestors must be declared to prevent clickjacking — use 'none' or 'self'.
connect-src, style-src, font-src, object-src must not use bare wildcard '*'.
